title: A Justice Lens on Fairness and Ethics Courses in Computing Education: LLM-Assisted Multi-Perspective and Thematic Evaluation
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the study. The analysis centered on justice-oriented practices, inclusive pedagogy, and the framing of fairness and ethics in AI/ML education syllabi.
